name: yaml.load
title: Convert a YAML string into R objects

origin.description: Parses one document. y is TRUE, and a plain 1:20 stays the string 1:20.
origin.usage: yaml.load(string, as.named.list = TRUE, handlers = NULL, error.label = NULL, eval.expr = getOption("yaml.eval.expr"), merge.precedence = c("order", "override"), merge.warning = FALSE)
origin.details: Parses one document. y is TRUE, and a plain 1:20 stays the string 1:20.
origin.value: yaml.load of flag y and clock 1:20 returns TRUE and the string 1:20.

translation.description: Parses one document. y is TRUE, and a plain 1:20 stays the string 1:20.
translation.usage: yaml_load(string, as_named_list=True, handlers=None, error_label=None, eval_expr=missing, merge_precedence="order", merge_warning=False)
translation.details: Parses one document. y is TRUE, and a plain 1:20 stays the string 1:20.
translation.value: yaml.load of flag y and clock 1:20 returns TRUE and the string 1:20.
translation.example:
from r_yaml import yaml_load
print(yaml_load("flag: y\nclock: 1:20\n"))
